title: Hyperliquid (HYPE) Overview: Price, Market Data, and Risk
content:

Hyperliquid is a layer one (L1) blockchain best known for perpetual futures and spot trading. Data snapshot date: May 14, 2026. ## Market Position for HYPE

Hyperliquid trades at $39.06 with a market cap of $9.32B and 24h volume of $301.14M. The latest ranked market snapshot places HYPE at #14 by market capitalization. The token is -34.14% from its all-time high of $59.3, recorded on September 18, 2025. Its all-time low is $3.81, recorded on November 29, 2024, while the 30-day move is -12.75%. Circulating supply is 238,385,315.95, total supply is 962,274,028.95, and max supply is 1,000,000,000. The volume-to-market-cap ratio is 3.23%, which helps separate active markets from thin markets. A higher ratio usually means recent trading activity is easier to observe, while a very low ratio can make price changes less reliable as a signal.

## TokenRadar Risk Context

TokenRadar currently assigns Hyperliquid a risk score of 5/10, a growth potential index of 13/100, narrative strength of 30/100, and a volatility index of 69/100. The computed risk level is medium. Hyperliquid is a limited upside token.

Risk should be read together with liquidity. Hyperliquid has 24h high and low levels of $40.36 and $38.27, so the short-term range is visible before considering broader 7-day and 30-day changes of -9.40% and -12.75%.

## Historical Data Points

The historical reference set for HYPE includes an all-time high of $59.3 on September 18, 2025, an all-time low of $3.81 on November 29, 2024, and a 1-year move of +51.00%. These figures do not predict the future, but they show whether the current price is near extremes or in a middle range.

## Supply and Valuation

Circulating supply is 238,385,315.95, total supply is 962,274,028.95, and max supply is 1,000,000,000. Fully diluted valuation is $37.62B. Market cap and FDV can diverge when a large portion of supply is not circulating, so investors should compare circulating supply, total supply, and unlock or emission information before relying on valuation multiples.

## What Could Change the Setup

Hyperliquid would need stronger evidence across volume, liquidity, development activity, and category momentum for the setup to improve. Weak follow-through, falling volume, large unlocks, contract migrations, or negative security events would weaken the research case even if the spot price rises for a short period.

## FAQ

**What is Hyperliquid?**

Hyperliquid is a layer one (L1) blockchain best known for perpetual futures and spot trading.

**Is HYPE a low-risk asset?**

No crypto asset should be treated as low risk by default. TokenRadar currently shows a risk score of 5/10, and that score should be checked against volatility, liquidity, supply, and recent events.

**What market data matters most for HYPE?**

The most useful starting points are price, market cap, 24h volume, market rank, ATH distance, circulating supply, and the 30-day trend.

**Does this overview recommend buying Hyperliquid?**

No. It is a structured research summary for comparing data points and risks.
